ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white pixels dominate approximately 80% of the visible surface, with low-intensity black pixels localized at the margins and tip regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous white central regions on both lobes; a continuous low-intensity black band along the trailing edge; concentrated clusters of black linear blobs at the distal left and right tips; dark pigmentation concentrated around the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Calculated pixel angle of approximately 45 degrees at the central vertex; depth extends to roughly 12% of the visible fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration pattern along the entire trailing edge; multiple sharp peaks and irregular valleys with an amplitude of approximately 5-15 pixels relative to the mean edge line.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex curvature on the upper leading margins terminating in acute distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Parallel high-contrast dark linear marks (rake marks) on the distal white surfaces; right tip contains 5 distinct vertical-to-oblique lines; left tip contains similar clustered disruptions.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive rake mark scarring on both distal tips; irregular, potentially traumatic tissue indentation on the extreme left lobe tip with associated dark/discolored pixels.
other_distinctive_markers: A singular, isolated dark focal spot located in the inner-lower quadrant of the white field on the right lobe.
